name: Maria
source:
[url=/c43961]Gerhart's[/url] younger sister and a member of the Kairyuu Knight Troupe.
Because she was raised surrounded by men she has a pretty course personality, but she's a bright and kind girl.
Among the knights where there aren't many women she's a very helpful friend for Teresa.
